description: This file is a Perl script designed for generating Redboot configuration scripts based on input kernel and root filesystem files. It includes command-line argument parsing, file size retrieval, and script generation functions.

methods.name: parse_num
methods.description: Converts a string number to its numeric value, interpreting hexadecimal if prefixed with 0x.

methods.name: gen_script
methods.description: Generates a Redboot boot script based on input files and parameters, writing output to a specified file.
